Definition: Normal glomeruli by LM but mesangial immune deposits by IF
Clinical Findings: None relevant to kidney; excellent kidney prognosisa

Definition: Mesangial hypercellularity (4 or more nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in the mesangial area excluding the hilar region) with mesangial immune deposits
Urine Findings: Microscopic hematuria; proteinuria, if present, is usually low grade
Clinical Findings: Preserved kidney function; hypertension infrequent; excellent kidney prognosisa

Definition: Segmental or global, active endocapillary or extracapillary, or inactive glomerulonephritis affecting <50% of glomeruli with mesangial and subendothelial immune deposits
Clinical Findings: Hypertension possible; kidney failure and nephrotic syndrome not unusual; variable kidney prognosis

Definition: Segmental or global active endocapillary or extracapillary, or inactive glomerulonephritis affecting ≥50% of glomeruli with mesangial and subendothelial immune deposits
Clinical Findings: Hypertension; kidney failure and nephrotic syndrome frequent; variable kidney prognosis

Definition: Glomerular basement membrane thickening with subepithelial and mesangial immune deposits; can occur alone or in combination with class III or IV
Clinical Findings: Anti-PLA2R antibody negative; preserved kidney function; nephrotic syndrome common; kidney prognosis gooda

Definition: ≥90% of glomeruli globally sclerosed without residual disease activity
